name: logen-khpay
description: Logen KHPay - multi-user ABA PayWay + Bakong KHQR API platform

scripts.build: pip install -r requirements.txt && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: python3 -m alembic upgrade head && python3 -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000} --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips='*' --workers 1
